_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Find and read my files
scenarios.description: Search and read; never change, never share.

scenarios.label: Summarise a folder
scenarios.description: Read everything in one folder and tell me what is there.

scenarios.label: Create notes into a folder
scenarios.description: Write new files where I say; touch nothing else.

scenarios.label: Organise and rename
scenarios.description: Move, rename and copy files across my Dropbox.

scenarios.label: Share links for me
scenarios.description: Create shared links and file requests.

scenarios.label: A full file agent
scenarios.description: Read, write, delete and share, as I would.
